summary: Derive shrinking-tree read sources and check admitted and obsolete two-stage executions.

examined.reason: Add generic lane/stage source selection and actual positive/negative two-stage candidates. Derive source identity rather than assume read results. Retain the full emitted entry coverage, actual publication existence, read-site and barrier obligations explicitly.
Describe the new source-selection and checked two-stage result without claiming full 256-thread reduction or solver correspondence.
Mathematical equations, reference implementation, emitted PTX and runtime are unchanged.

No primitive semantics or old theorem hypotheses changed. Combined lane guards are explicitly restricted control, not a proof about emitted predicate instructions. The necessary source rules remain distinct from full PTX admission, and the concrete history regression is distinct from universal whole-kernel correctness.

results.method: Five sequential capped Lean module checks; full exact declaration dependency audit; dependency and source guards; saved-code binding refresh; manual proof/scope review; receipt hashes and Stratic snapshot/link validation.
results.environment: Pinned Lean 4.34.0, 16 dependency pins. Heavy checks use 6 GiB hard cgroups, no swap, 150 percent CPU quota; new Lean checks use one thread. No GPU or paid model calls.
results.evidence: 4772 exact dependency reports, only allowed standard Lean axioms; 568 guarded sources. Generic lane ownership and instruction-order proofs derive WritersAround; eight-stage shrinking active ranges derive own-read gaps and last neighbor writes. Coverage, actual selected publications and barrier edges remain explicit kernel obligations. The four-lane two-stage candidate uses actual pair-update instructions, combined lane guards and barrier steps. Its event history and all-lane completion are checked; explicit sources satisfy compatibility and necessary repeated-write rules. General final-input/store selection for actual runs of the given history shape forces four and six, then ten. A second actual obsolete-neighbor candidate has byte-compatible sources but fails ordered admission, so the negative test is nonvacuous. The positive witness is concrete; no arbitrary-input or arbitrary-history complete tree theorem is claimed. Saved bindings refreshed for 720 contractions, 630 stores, residual entries and 1440 local updates in 30 layouts. Source-identical legacy build targets were reused after hash verification; binding and dependency audits reran. Full legacy rebuild/interpreter suite and hardware runs were not repeated. All receipt hashes match, descriptions/links validate, snapshots agree and README is unchanged. Full emitted predicate/control, ownership/coverage, input loop, complete tree and solver correspondence remain open.
